# HttpResponse

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

HTTP result with status, headers and a bounded retained body, or an invalid value with details in `Error.Last()`.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#http-objects-400).

## Bytes

```PPL
HttpResponse.Bytes() BYTES
```

Instance function.

Returns the retained response body as `BYTES`, whatever it contains. Use it instead of `Text()` for images, archives and any other binary body.

## ContentType

`HttpResponse.ContentType: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only response metadata. Check Valid before relying on network results and OK for a 2xx status.

## Header

```PPL
HttpResponse.Header(STRING name) STRING
```

Instance function.

Returns the selected response header, or an empty string when it is absent.

## Save

```PPL
HttpResponse.Save(STRING file) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Writes the retained response body atomically to a board-relative file.

## Text

```PPL
HttpResponse.Text() STRING
```

Instance function.

Decodes the retained response body strictly as UTF-8. Invalid text reports `ErrCode.Format`.
